title: Assets
lead: Characters, scenes, props, on-screen text and voices are found in the script automatically. Lock one candidate for each, and every shot uses the same reference.

detail.label: Asset details
detail.desc: Description (the intent layer of this asset's prompt)
detail.descHint: Click Rerun to apply changes; editing a locked asset shows which shots are affected.
detail.descSaved: Description saved; it applies to the next rerun.
detail.lockedCharacter: “{{name}}” locked: candidate {{letter}} is the reference; side, back and expression views are being filled in.
detail.unlockTitle: Unlocking “{{name}}” affects the shots that use it
detail.uploaded: Uploaded “{{name}}”: it is a candidate now, and picked.

text.exact: Text in the frame (checked letter by letter)

hint.composite: Generate the plate without text and composite the text in post. The text is always right; best for screens, signs and captions.
hint.model: The text is part of the image, with natural perspective and strokes; best for handwritten notes. Every candidate is OCR-checked and mismatches cannot be adopted directly.

cands.title: Candidates
cands.noteText: Every candidate is OCR-checked against the text above
cands.noteComposite: Every plate is OCR-checked to be free of text; the text on top previews what post will add
cands.madeWith: This version shows “{{text}}”, made with “{{method}}”; the text or method has changed since, so rerun to use the current settings
cands.noteCharacter: Side, back and expression views are filled in after locking
cands.label: v{{n}} · {{letter}}
cands.ocrMissing: OCR mismatch: missing characters or punctuation
cands.ocrBlank: OCR: no text on the plate
cands.ocrHasText: OCR found text on the plate: “{{read}}”
cands.ocrUnchecked: Not OCR-checked: no OCR available on this computer
cands.emptyImage: Not generated yet. Click Rerun above or on the right for 4 candidates.
cands.emptyVoice: Not generated yet. Click Rerun above or on the right for 3 voice candidates.

hint.design: Creates a new voice from the description above; no sample needed. MiniMax voice design is about $3 each.
hint.clone: Upload at least 10 s of clean speech (with the speaker's consent). MiniMax cloning is about $1.5 each.
hint.local: All local and free: the chosen audition is the voice, and IndexTTS makes the emotion variants. Quality depends on the audition.

voice.label: v{{n}} · {{letter}} · {{label}}
voice.lines: Audition with lines from the script
voice.note: Three free auditions first; choose one and make the final, which is what gets locked
voice.needsFinal: An audition cannot be locked: make the final first
voice.finalStarted: Making the final from candidate {{letter}}: the voice, then five emotion variants.
voice.variantsHint: Dialogue audio uses the emotion that matches each line's delivery.

lockMismatch.title: Candidate {{letter}} does not show the required text
lockMismatch.hint: Once locked, every later shot follows this picture. Lock it only if the text is right.

reanalyzing: Analysing the script again; the list updates when it is done and new assets show up in it.

final.started: Making the final: candidate {{letter}} as the reference, one picture on {{model}}.

views.title: Extra views
views.note: Drawn from the locked picture once it is locked; locking another one redraws them
views.running: Drawing the side, back and expressions from the locked picture…
views.stale: The locked picture changed; waiting to redraw
views.none: The side, back and expressions are drawn once it is locked.

matrix.label: Appearance matrix
matrix.hint: One row per scene, one column per asset. The number is how many lines of the scene have it; click to jump to that line in the script.
matrix.empty: No assets analysed for this episode yet.
